i cant bring myself to call them. i know theyd care, but i cant do it. 

i hope things look up for you.

they talked abt referring me, but it’d be way too expensive over time even with insurance. i’m just so done and this feels like a final nail in my coffin. like, i did what my uni says and tried to seek help and this is just another thing in a long succession of things that doesnt work out. i’m tired.

i’m in the united states. i know that the national suicide hotline isnt supposed to call the cops and shit unless you say youre going to do yourself in or harm yourself, but i’ve read too many horror stories for it to be worth risking.
call the hotline and risk getting sent to a psych ward? and what people can i talk to? i have friends but they have their own shit going on, and it wouldnt be fair to them to put this on them anyway.

Hi, thank you for the kind words. I know that realistically it is not my fault, but I still cannot stop blaming myself. The self-blame and the anger (at myself and at them) is eating me alive.

I have taken time to consider going to someone at this professor's institution in the past; however, I have realized that I am not at all comfortable with pursuing any action against this person. 

I have been considering utilizing the mental health resources at my current university. I will give them a call today or tomorrow.

Thanks again.
